## Profile

Statistician and developer working on **data visualisation and web development**. I research how to make machine learning explanations visible and trustworthy, and I build open-source software and interactive tools to do it.
I have industry experience in Shiny and R package engineering, I teach at Monash, and I have a track record of community talks and workshops.
I'm looking for roles building interactive data visualisation and web tools.
